_comment: The editorial source of truth for the My Work gallery and for every product
photograph used elsewhere on the site.
Each entry names a file under media/gallery/<category>/<slug>.png. Those are the
originals supplied by Hazel and they are deliberately NOT inside public/, because
they are ~2.7 MB each and would otherwise all ship to Vercel. The browser only ever
sees the derivatives written to public/images/gallery/ by
Order here is the order shown on the page. Captions are the visible label, kicker is
the small gold line under it, alt is what a screen reader and a failed image show.
After editing this file run, from the repo root:
